COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
20.11.2023 Com pounding Application (I A No. 4 of 2023)
I n
C-482 No. 737 of 2020
Hon ' b le Rak esh Th ap liy al, J.
1. Mr. D.N. Sharma, learned counsel holding brief of
Mr. Paritosh Dalakoti, appears for the applicant, Mr.
V.S. Pal, learned Assistant Government Advocate
appears for the State and Mr. Akshay Latwal, learned
counsel for respondent No. 2.
2. I n the instant C-482 petition, a Compounding
Application (I A No. 4 of 2023) has been moved, which
is supported by the affidavits of the applicant as well as
of the complainant (respondent No. 2).
3. I n the Com pounding Application, it is contended
that the applicant and the complainant have entered
into an agreement with their free will and now they do
not wish to pursue this case. Respondent No. 2, who
appears through Virtual Conference mode, also subm its
that the divorce has already taken place and hence, she
does not want to pursue this case. Both the applicant,
who is physically present in the Court and respondent
No. 2, who is appearing before the Court through
Virtual Conference mode, have been identified by their
respective counsel through their Aadhar Cards.
4. This crim inal case, in fact, initiated pursuant to
the First I nformation Report lodged by respondent No.
2 on 07.12.2019 and after investigation, charge-sheet

was filed for the offence punishable under Section 498A
of I PC, Police Station Kathgodam , District Nainital.
5. This Court has interacted with the applicant as
well as the com plainant (respondent No. 2), and they
both subm it before this Court that now they do not
wish to pursue this proceeding.
6. After taking into consideration the averm ents, as
made in the Compounding Application, this Court is of
the view that this Com pounding Application should be
allowed and the pending proceeding be quashed.
7. I n view of this, the Compounding Application is
allowed. The proceeding of Crim inal Case No. 1905 of
2020 State of Uttarakhand vs. Brijesh Kumar for the
offence punishable under Section 498A of I PC arising
out of FIR No. 245 of 2019, P.S. Kathgodam , District
Nainital pending in the Court of Upper Chief Judicial
Magistrate, Haldwani, District Nainital is quashed.
8. I n view of this, the present C-482 petition is also
disposed of.
 ( Rak esh Th ap liy al, J)
 20.11.2023
Rathour
